title: East Lake Escape
specs: Must be 25 years of age or older to rent
If born after 1/1/98, must complete Georgia boater safety course
All renters must watch a 10-minute DNR safety video prior to rental
gap: Exact hours for each rental duration not stated
blurb: Guests rent 140hp 24' Bentley pontoon boats to explore Lake Sinclair. Boats provide room for friends and family to relax and enjoy the lake. Rentals include delivery and pickup options for a fee based on distance.
extraNote: $250 deposit collected to hold reservations · 24-hour notice required for cancellation refunds · Deposit refunded upon inspection and fuel replenished at end of rental · Boats can be delivered and picked up at your dock for a fee based on distance from Cosby's Landing · Boat ramp on Carrs Station Road, East Lake area, Lake Sinclair, Georgia · March 16 through September 29 (peak season) and September 30 through March 15 (off season)
